motive.summary: Marrow was embezzling from a research trial he ran for Vance and had been secretly over-medicating (drugging) Vance to keep him confused and unable to notice the theft.
motive.details: Saturday night, Vance confronted Marrow directly with proof of the embezzlement (a ledger discrepancy he'd found himself). Marrow, facing exposure and ruin on the eve of the heir announcement, killed him in a panic rather than plan.

weapon.name: the Ammonite
weapon.description: A large, heavy fossil ammonite from Vance's personal collection, normally kept on display in the Study.

mover_reason: Hettie found Vance's body in the Study during her late rounds. She had seen Wren loitering near the Study minutes earlier and, panicking, wrongly concluded Wren was the killer. To protect Wren by disconnecting the crime scene from that sighting, Hettie dragged the body to the Library and staged it there. She is guilty of tampering with a crime scene, not of the murder.
camera_gap_connection: Colonel Slate cut the Corridor security feed that night for a reason unrelated to the murder (a private, unmonitored moment with Hettie, whom she is secretly in a relationship with). The Study, Library, and Storage Room are all reachable only via the Corridor, so Slate's gap coincidentally gave Hettie unwitnessed cover to move the body afterward. Slate does not know Hettie moved a body during that window; Hettie and Slate parted ways partway through the gap before Hettie continued her rounds alone.
killers_blind_spot: Marrow killed Vance in the Study and fled immediately to hide the Ammonite. He has no knowledge that Hettie later moved the body to the Library. As far as he knows, the body should still be in the Study -- so news that it was 'found in the Library' is privately disorienting to him, and he must never voice that confusion aloud.

master_timeline.event: Dinner. Vance reiterates he will name his heir Sunday at noon. Tension among guests.
Storm closes in; boat service to the mainland is suspended for the night.
Marrow brings Vance his evening medication in the Study, as he does most nights. Alone together, Vance produces a ledger page proving Marrow has been skimming trial funds.
Marrow, cornered, kills Vance in the Study with the Ammonite fossil from Vance's own display case.
Marrow flees the Study, carries the Ammonite to the Storage Room (a Corridor dead-end) and hides it there, then rejoins the other guests to establish a normal presence.
Wren slips toward the Study, hoping to search Vance's desk for will/heir paperwork. She sees the door ajar, gets spooked by the dark room, and leaves without entering or noticing the body.
Colonel Slate cuts the Corridor camera feed for a private moment with Hettie, unrelated to the murder.
Slate and Hettie part ways; the feed is still down.
Hettie, on her late rounds, finds Vance's body in the Study. She recalls seeing Wren near the Study minutes earlier and wrongly concludes Wren is the killer.
Panicking, Hettie drags the body through the (still uncovered) Corridor into the Library and stages the scene there to disconnect it from the Study and, in her mind, from Wren.
Slate restores the Corridor camera feed, unaware of what happened during the gap.
Barnaby and Odette, gathering the household after the storm worsens, discover Vance's body in the Library. The alarm is raised.
The nine-hour storm window: the detective (player) investigates while everyone is stranded, before the boat arrives.
